mapper.select: SELECT id, keyword, display_order, start_date, end_date, enabled, memo, created_at, created_ip, created_by, updated_at, updated_ip, updated_by FROM tn_search_recommend_keyword WHERE enabled = true AND (start_date IS NULL OR start_date <= #{today}) AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= #{today}) ORDER BY display_order ASC, id ASC
